    round_scores = payload['round_scores']
    round_targets = payload['round_targets']
    forced = payload['forced']
    n_rounds = len(round_scores)
    lengths = [len(scores) for scores in round_scores]
    forced_per_round = [[] for _ in range(n_rounds)]
    for idx in forced:
        cum = 0
        for r in range(n_rounds):
            if idx < cum + lengths[r]:
                local = idx - cum
                forced_per_round[r].append(local)
                break
            cum += lengths[r]
    result = []
    for r in range(n_rounds):
        scores = round_scores[r]
        target = round_targets[r]
        forced_set = set(forced_per_round[r])
        selected = list(forced_set)
        remaining = [(scores[i], i) for i in range(len(scores)) if i not in forced_set]
        remaining.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
        needed = target - len(forced_set)
        selected.extend([i for _, i in remaining[:needed]])
        result.append(selected)
    return {"selected_per_round": result}"}
